insight: Raised a $1.4B Series C led by SoftBank, with NVIDIA and Jeff Bezos, lifting its valuation past $14B in early 2026.
name: Skild AI
tagline: A single, omni-bodied foundation model designed to control any robot.
description: Skild AI builds Skild Brain, a general-purpose robotics foundation model intended to control diverse embodiments — quadrupeds, humanoids, tabletop arms, mobile manipulators — without prior knowledge of a robot's exact form. It pretrains on large-scale simulation and internet video, then post-trains on targeted real-world data for customer deployments.
edge: One 'omni-bodied' foundation model meant to control any robot it never trained on, via in-context adaptation in the wild.
pros: Pretrains on sim + internet human video
In-context learning adapts to new bodies
cons: Foundation model, not a shipping consumer product
Generality claims still being validated in-field

references.title: Skild AI raises $1.4B to build 'omni-bodied' robot brain
